# Changes to Darkly

This folder is a renamed copy of [Bali10050/Darkly](https://github.com/Bali10050/Darkly) at tag `v0.5.41`, commit `6fc65177b22983d54aa965ea3617f8c9d658f442`. It builds the application style and the window decoration named Frosty, which can be installed next to the real Darkly.

This file is the notice of changes that the GNU GPL asks for. lukk17 changed the files of this folder as listed below: the renaming of point 3 changed the code, the build files, the plugin metadata and the translations, and every other point names the files and lines it changed. Points 1 to 11 were made from 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-22. Every later point starts with the date of its change. Comments, copyright and license headers, `AUTHORS` and `COPYING` stay as upstream wrote them.

The files `kstyle/frostyquickwindowblur.h`, `kstyle/tests/dolphinstatusbar_test.cpp` and `kstyle/tests/windowbackground_test.cpp` are new files by lukk17, under GPL-2.0-or-later like the Darkly files around them. `LICENSE.MIT` is new too, see point 18.

### 0.0.1, 2026-10-22, lukk17

1. Left out files that the build does not use: `.github/`, `flatpak/`, `nix/`, `flake.nix`, `flake.lock`, `logos/`, `darklylogo.svg`, `darklylogotext.svg`, `README.md`, `install.sh`, `uninstall.sh`, `.gitignore`, `kdecoration/Messages.sh` and `kstyle/config/Messages.sh`.
2. Left out Darkly's own Plasma Style (`desktoptheme/`) and color scheme (`colors/Darkly.colors`). Renamed, they would have taken the names of the Frosty Plasma Style (`frosty`) and of `Frosty.colors`. In `CMakeLists.txt` the line `add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/desktoptheme ...)`, the function `build_colors` and its call were removed for that reason.
3. Renamed `Darkly` to `Frosty`, `darkly` to `frosty` and `DARKLY` to `FROSTY` everywhere outside comments: in the code, the strings, the build files, the plugin metadata, the translations and the file and folder names. This covers the C++ namespace, the style key, the config file `frostyrc`, the D-Bus names, the plugin and library names, the translation domains and the settings tool. Comments, copyright and license headers, `AUTHORS` and `COPYING` are unchanged, so some comments still say Darkly or name the old file.
4. The window decoration plugin file is `com.github.lukk17.frosty` (`OUTPUT_NAME` in `kdecoration/CMakeLists.txt`), so its plugin id is `com.github.lukk17.frosty`. `FrostyConfig.cmake.in` uses the same id.
5. Changed defaults in `kstyle/frosty.kcfg`, group `Style`: `DolphinViewOpacity` from 100 to 75, and `DolphinSidebarOpacity`, `ToolBarOpacity`, `TabBarOpacity` and `MenuBarOpacity` from 100 to 70. `MenuOpacity` and the other entries are unchanged.
6. Changed defaults in `kdecoration/frostysettingsdata.kcfg`, group `Windeco`: `BlurTransparentTitleBar` and `MatchInactiveTitleBar` from false to true.
7. `kdecoration/frostydecoration.cpp` line 193: the fallback in `readEntry("ToolBarOpacity", 100)` changed to 70, the new `ToolBarOpacity` default, so the title bar is 70 percent opaque and blurred also when `~/.config/frostyrc` has no `ToolBarOpacity` line.
8. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` line 2409 and `kstyle/config/frostystyleconfig.cpp` line 381: the move of the old `TransparentDolphinView` setting runs while `DolphinViewOpacity` is still at its default of 75 (upstream compares with 100, its own default). The comment above line 381 still says "default 100", because upstream comments are kept unchanged.
9. The `== 100` tests in `Helper::transparentBarBgColor` (`kstyle/frostyhelper.cpp` lines 1965, 1980 and 1995) are left as they are. They test for a fully opaque bar, not for a default.
10. The upstream unit tests expect the new defaults: `testDefaultValue` (line 61) and `testPersistence` (line 110) in `kstyle/tests/dolphinviewopacity_test.cpp`, and `testSliderDefaultValue` (lines 78 and 84) in `kstyle/tests/styleconfig_test.cpp`, compare with 75. Their comments still say 100.
11. `VERSION` changed from `0.5.41` to `0.0.1`, the version of this first Frosty release. CMake reads it as the project version.
12. (2026-11-07) Blur behind Qt Quick windows. Darkly asks KWin for blur only for widget windows, so Qt Quick and Kirigami applications such as filelight, System Monitor, KDE Connect, Haruna and Spectacle got a see-through window from the Frosty Window colour with a sharp wallpaper behind it.
    1. `kstyle/frostyquickwindowblur.h` is new. Its function `quickWindowBlur` decides for one `QQuickWindow`. It skips a window that is hidden, drawn off screen (`QQuickRenderControl::renderWindowFor` returns a window), not of type `Qt::Window` or `Qt::Dialog`, or frameless. It asks to remove the blur when the window colour is fully opaque, and asks for blur otherwise.
    2. `kstyle/frostyblurhelper.cpp` and `kstyle/frostyblurhelper.h`: the new `BlurHelper::updateQuickWindow` calls `KWindowEffects::enableBlurBehind` with that answer. The corners of the whole window blur moved from `BlurHelper::blurRegion` into the new function `windowBlurRegion`, which both use. A Qt Quick window therefore gets the same corners as a widget window: square when maximized or full screen, four round corners with `FloatingTitlebar` (the default), else two round corners at the bottom.
    3. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` `Style::eventFilter` calls `updateQuickWindow` on `Show`, `Resize` and `WindowStateChange` of every window. It does not do this in applications listed in `OpaqueApps` or `ForceOpaque`, in applications with a fractional scale, which get opaque windows, and in plasmashell. plasmashell is recognised by the new member `_isPlasmaShell` in `kstyle/frostystyle.h`, set in `Style::polish`.
    4. `kstyle/tests/blurhelper_test.cpp` has 8 new tests for `quickWindowBlur`, and `kstyle/tests/CMakeLists.txt` links this test with Qt Quick.
13. (2026-11-10) One glass value for every see-through part, 65 percent.
    1. `kstyle/frosty.kcfg`, group `Style`: the defaults of `DolphinSidebarOpacity`, `DolphinViewOpacity`, `MenuBarOpacity`, `ToolBarOpacity` and `TabBarOpacity` changed to 65, from the 70 and 75 of point 5.
    2. `kdecoration/frostydecoration.cpp` line 193: the fallback in `readEntry("ToolBarOpacity", 70)` of point 7 changed to 65.
    3. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` line 2424 and `kstyle/config/frostystyleconfig.cpp` line 381: the move of `TransparentDolphinView` of point 8 now compares with the new default 65. KConfig does not write a value equal to the default into `frostyrc`, so a user who had the old default 75 has no `DolphinViewOpacity` line and gets 65 without any extra step.
    4. The tests of point 10 expect 65: `testDefaultValue` (line 61) and `testPersistence` (line 110) in `kstyle/tests/dolphinviewopacity_test.cpp`, and `testSliderDefaultValue` (lines 78 and 84) in `kstyle/tests/styleconfig_test.cpp`.
14. (2026-11-10) The Dolphin status bar is glass like the tool bars.
    1. Dolphin 26.08 draws its full width status bar with `PE_PanelStatusBar` (`src/statusbar/dolphinstatusbar.cpp` line 473). Darkly draws nothing for this element, so the status bar showed the window background under it, and that background is close to solid. Qt fills the Window colour once because the style clears `WA_NoSystemBackground` (`kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` line 495), and `Style::eventFilter` fills it twice more (line 1754), as the event filter of the window (line 500) and of the whole application (line 213). Three layers of alpha 166 cover 96 percent. The tool bars, tab bars, the sidebar and the view erase that background first and then draw their own colour. The status bar did not.
    2. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` and `kstyle/frostystyle.h`: the new function `Style::drawPanelStatusBarPrimitive` draws `PE_PanelStatusBar` for the widget `DolphinStatusBar` in Dolphin the way a tool bar is drawn. It erases the area and fills it with the tool bar colour at `ToolBarOpacity`, through `Helper::transparentBarBgColor`. It does this only when `ToolBarOpacity` is below 100, the application is not opaque and the window is translucent. In every other case the element goes to the parent style as before. No setting was added.
    3. `kstyle/tests/dolphinstatusbar_test.cpp` is new, and `kstyle/tests/CMakeLists.txt` builds it after the style plugin. The test loads the built plugin, puts a widget with the class name, children and paint event of Dolphin's status bar into a translucent window, and checks that the status bar has the alpha of `ToolBarOpacity`. Before this change the alpha there was 244.
15. (2026-11-10) Plain window areas are painted once, at the alpha of the Window colour.
    1. Darkly installed `Style` as the event filter of the application object for Qt 6 (`this->addEventFilter(qApp)`), to get `QEvent::ApplicationPaletteChange` in place of the Qt 5 signal `QApplication::paletteChanged`. A filter on the application object gets every event of every object. `Style` is also the event filter of the widgets it polishes, so `Style::eventFilter` ran twice for each event of those widgets: once for the application and once for the widget. A translucent window got Qt's own fill of the Window colour, because the style clears `WA_NoSystemBackground`, and two more fills from the two runs of `Style::eventFilter`. Three layers of alpha 166 cover 96 percent. The other paint handlers for single widgets ran twice as well, for example the separator of a `QDialogButtonBox`.
    2. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` lines 176 to 196: the new class `ApplicationEventFilter` is the event filter of the application object (line 234). It passes each event to the new function `Style::applicationEventFilter` (lines 1816 to 1852, declared in `kstyle/frostystyle.h` line 141). This function now holds the three things that need every event of the application, moved out of `Style::eventFilter` with the same conditions: the palette change, `BlurHelper::updateQuickWindow` for Qt Quick windows, and the update of the blur region on `Move`, `Show`, `Hide` and `Resize` of a widget in a translucent window. The blur region update now also runs for scroll areas, dock widgets, MDI windows, command link buttons, combo box popups and framed dialog button boxes, whose own handler returned before it in Darkly. It never eats an event. `Style::eventFilter` now runs only as the filter of the widgets that `Style::polish` registers, once per event. For Qt 5 the `paletteChanged` connection stays, and the new filter is installed too.
    3. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` lines 1759 and 1761: `Style::eventFilter` fills the background of a translucent window with `CompositionMode_Source`, so the fill replaces Qt's fill under it instead of adding a layer. A plain area has exactly the Window colour, alpha 166, 65 percent cover. The separator line under the title bar is still drawn over it with `CompositionMode_SourceOver`.
    4. Tool bars, tab bars, menu bars, the Dolphin sidebar, the Dolphin view and the Dolphin status bar erase the window background before they draw their own colour, so they are not changed. Menus and tooltips are not drawn by this filter. Opaque applications (`OpaqueApps`, `ForceOpaque`, fractional scale) and windows that are not translucent never reach this fill. Measured in Dolphin under Xvfb with picom: the tool bar, sidebar, view and status bar have the same pixels with the old and the new plugin, and only the one pixel wide gap between the sidebar and the view changed, from 96 to 65 percent cover.
    5. `kstyle/tests/windowbackground_test.cpp` is new, and `kstyle/tests/CMakeLists.txt` builds it after the style plugin. It loads the built plugin and checks that a plain area of a translucent `QWidget` window has alpha 166, and that the separator of a `QDialogButtonBox` with the force frame property is drawn once. With the old plugin both checks fail: the plain area had alpha 244, and the separator pixel was `#b127272a` instead of `#ac19191c`.
16. (2026-11-10) One glass value of 80 percent, up from the 65 percent of point 13.
    1. `kstyle/frosty.kcfg` lines 332, 336, 345, 349 and 353, group `Style`: the defaults of `DolphinSidebarOpacity`, `DolphinViewOpacity`, `MenuBarOpacity`, `ToolBarOpacity` and `TabBarOpacity` changed from 65 to 80. `MenuOpacity` stays 100.
    2. `kdecoration/frostydecoration.cpp` line 193: the fallback in `readEntry("ToolBarOpacity", 65)` of point 13 changed to 80.
    3. `kstyle/frostystyle.cpp` line 2456 and `kstyle/config/frostystyleconfig.cpp` line 381: the move of `TransparentDolphinView` of point 8 now compares with the new default 80. A user who had the old default 65 has no `DolphinViewOpacity` line in `frostyrc` and gets 80 without any extra step.
    4. The tests of point 10 expect 80: `testDefaultValue` (line 61) and `testPersistence` (line 110) in `kstyle/tests/dolphinviewopacity_test.cpp`, and `testSliderDefaultValue` (lines 78 and 84) in `kstyle/tests/styleconfig_test.cpp`. `kstyle/tests/dolphinstatusbar_test.cpp` and `kstyle/tests/windowbackground_test.cpp` keep their own Window colour with alpha 166. The first compares with `ToolBarOpacity` and the second with the alpha of that Window colour, so neither expects the color scheme value.
17. (2026-11-10) Removed `.clang-format`. It is not part of Darkly v0.5.41. ECM's `KDEClangFormat`, called from `CMakeLists.txt` line 208, copies its own `clang-format.cmake` to `.clang-format` in this folder when `clang-format` is installed and the file is missing (extra-cmake-modules 6.31 `kde-modules/KDEClangFormat.cmake` lines 57 to 69), so a build makes it again with the same content. The project `.gitignore` keeps that copy out of git.
18. (2026-11-10) Added `LICENSE.MIT`: the MIT permission notice with the copyright lines of the 29 Darkly files that carry it, listed under MIT in `REUSE.toml`. The package installs it as `/usr/share/licenses/frosty/MIT.txt`, in place of the MIT template from `LICENSES`.

| `/usr/share/applications/kcm_darklydecoration.desktop` | `/usr/share/applications/kcm_frostydecoration.desktop` |
